title: Content delivery: bundled starter pack loading, CDN catalog, atomic pack install (Unit 11)
accept: pack_loader loads a pack bundle (built by lib/pipeline/pack_builder code in a test setup) into §5 content models end-to-end: text renders (models parse), audio refs resolve to files, Rive refs resolve (Unit 3 acceptance's app-side half; integration test).

content_repository merges the bundled starter pack (always present from the binary/assets) with installed CDN packs and exposes stories/twisters to the app; the app is fully functional having never seen the network (offline_e2e_test: repository over starter pack only, airplane-mode fake transport, full content graph available — transcribed 'fresh install in airplane mode' acceptance at the data layer).
catalog_client checks a static catalog.json on launch when online (faked transport); catalog fetch failure is silent — installed content unaffected.
Download policy: new packs download in the background on Wi-Fi by default (connectivity abstraction, faked); checksum verified BEFORE install.

Atomic install (verify → swap): a failed or partial download never corrupts installed content — corrupt/truncated pack fixture is rejected and installed content untouched (transcribed acceptance; test tampers bytes and asserts prior pack intact).
minAppVersion respected: a catalog pack requiring a newer app is hidden, never downloaded-and-broken (transcribed acceptance).
Download resumes/retries across app restarts (simulated interruption: downloader state persisted, resumed on next construction — transcribed acceptance).
No user data flows upward: catalog/download requests carry no identifiers, no user payloads (test asserts request shape — download-only contract).

GraphemeSound inventory (Unit 15): content_repository exposes the full grapheme inventory from the bundled starter content and merges example-word EXTENSIONS arriving with installed packs; a card's example words with no downloaded audio are reported as unavailable so the Sound Garden shows only words it has audio for (tests: starter-only inventory, pack extension merge, partially-resolved refs).
pinned_design: Unit 11 pinned: packs are static, versioned, checksummed bundles on a CDN — no dynamic backend, download-only, no user data upward. App checks static catalog.json on launch when online; background download on Wi-Fi by default; checksum verified before install; atomic install verify → swap; failed/partial download never corrupts installed content. Starter pack always present from the binary (A-9: ~8 stories covering all three age-band starting levels); fully functional with no network ever. minAppVersion: too-new packs hidden. §6 Offline: bundled starter pack and all core loops fully offline; CDN packs work offline after download. A-15 pinned: integrity = SHA-256 checksum listed in the catalog ('signed checksum' satisfied by this in v1; signing post-POC). Unit 15 pinned: phoneme audio + grapheme inventory ship in the binary; example-word audio arrives with packs.
notes: No network in container: HTTP transport and connectivity are interfaces with fakes; real implementation uses dart:io HttpClient (no new pub dependency). File operations against injected temp directories (no path_provider in tests). Fixture packs are BUILT BY the pipeline code (pack-build-cli's lib/pipeline/pack_builder) inside test setup — reference that code, do not own it; this realizes Unit 3's 'pack build produces a bundle the app loads end-to-end'. CDN base URL / catalog hosting is OQ-6 — blocks pilot distribution, not build (local fixture servers/fakes here). Integrity scheme pinned by A-15 (former OD-6b resolved): SHA-256 checksum in catalog, no signing in v1. Full app-level airplane-mode e2e (UI included) lands in app-shell.
